correctness.rationale: For connected nonnegative three-edge conductances, characteristic polynomial λ(λ²-2sλ+3t) gives exact inverse D^{-1} on the range of L. Direct multiplication yields T_ij=4h[12x+6th-t(x-2(y+z))h²]/Δ, where Δ=48 det(D on 1-perp)>0. An edge numerator changes sign at a unique positive root iff x>2(y+z); two edges cannot satisfy this inequality. Diagonals are positive since the scalar rational factor r(u)=((u-3)²+3)/(u²+6u+12) is positive for u≥0. Two-vertex case is explicitly entrywise nonnegative. Program verify.py independently reconstructs inverse matrices exactly, with 30485 exact rational checks. The complete theorem follows from algebra, not finite sampling.
